nodes.name: SWNT Purification and Opening
nodes.procedure: SWNTs (P2-SWNTs) were refluxed in nitric acid (3.0 M) for three hours and filtered with deionised water, they were then heated at 600 C for 30 minutes to open the SWNT termini, giving a 50 % weight loss. Finally, they were sonicated for 30 minutes in concentrated HCl, filtered and washed with deionised water until a neutral pH was shown.

nodes.name: Co3O4@SWNT Synthesis
nodes.procedure: Co2(CO)8 (20 mg, 0.058 mmol) and freshly opened SWNTs (40 mg) were sealed in a glass ampoule under reduced pressure (10^-5 mbar) and heated to 38 C for 48 hours. The ampoule was allowed to cool to room temperature before exposing the sample to air. The composite was then stirred in 1.0 M hydrochloric acid for 30 minutes and then washed with deionised water until a neutral pH is seen in the washings.

nodes.name: RuO2@SWNT Synthesis
nodes.procedure: Ru3(CO)12 (20 mg, 0.031 mmol) and freshly opened SWNTs (40 mg) were sealed in a glass ampoule under reduced pressure (10^-5 mbar) and heated to 130 C for 48 hours. The ampoule was allowed to cool to room temperature before exposing the sample to air. The composite was then washed with acetonitrile (3 x 50 mL), allowed to dry and then heated in air at 150 C for 24 hours.

nodes.description: OER performance evaluation in alkaline media
nodes.source_text: Oxygen evolution activity was measured in oxygen-saturated 0.1 mol dm−3 potassium hydroxide at 1600 rpm. A Hg/HgO reference electrode and graphite rod counter electrode were used... All voltammograms were iR-corrected... Linear sweep voltammograms were measured at 5 mV s−1... temperature-controlled water bath at 25 °C.

Co3O4@SWNT, RuO2@SWNT and IrO2@SWNT were cycled 2000 times between 0.8 and 1.7 V (vs. RHE) in N2-saturated 0.10 M KOH at 100 mV s-1. RDE voltammetry of Co3O4@SWNT... before and after cycling showed almost no change in the electrocatalytic behaviour... The OER Tafel slopes decreased to 83... for Co3O4@SWNT.
The OER Tafel slopes decreased to 83, 67 and 77 mV dec-1 for Co3O4@SWNT, RuO2@SWNT and IrO2@SWNT, respectively, after 2000 cycles.

nodes.description: OER activity after plugging SWNT ends with C60 fullerenes
nodes.source_text: The OER activities of MOx@SWNT before and after plugging the ends of the SWNTs were very similar, with an increase in η10 of between 8 and 31 mV after plugging. This small increase in η10 is likely due to a decrease in electrochemical surface area by C60 adsorption into the SWNT network, as evidenced by a decrease in the capacitance by about ~5% after plugging.
